'File Name: mainnet/contracts/market/v0-4-market.clar -> Scope: Critical. Show a case where the mask actually written by market-vault after the call differs from the one the check validated - because a row hit zero, because a bit was already set, or because the check used the enabled-filtered mask - and land in an egroup that was never approved for the resulting position. Impact: protocol insolvency.'
